verdict.rationale: Extend explicitly advertises handwriting detection ('Detect tables, checkboxes, images, and handwriting') as part of its agentic OCR capability, and maintains a dedicated Confidence Scores doc for extraction outputs, directly matching the story's requirement of recognizing handwritten fields with confidence flagging. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating handwriting extraction accuracy, and no explicit doc tying confidence scores to handwriting/annotation fields specifically (vs. general extraction fields).
